The King and Queen of Sparta.
Scene one.
The Double Wedding at Sparta.
Telemachus and Pisistratus reach Menelaus's palace during a double wedding feast.
Whether strangers should be admitted?

Look, friend —
bronze flashing through the echoing halls, gold and amber, silver and ivory.

scenes.title: Recognition through Tears
scenes.card: When Menelaus speaks of Odysseus, Telemachus hides his tears; Helen recognizes him as Odysseus's son by his face, and all weep.

subs.text: Scene two.
Recognition through Tears.
Yet for no man of them all do I grieve as for Odysseus, who labored at Troy beyond us all.
His absence is sorrow to old Laertes, to steady Penelope, and to Telemachus,
the child he left new-born in his hall.
Menelaus, shall I speak what my eyes tell me?
Never have I seen such likeness in man or woman —
this must be Telemachus,
the son Odysseus left a baby at home when for my shameless sake the Achaeans sailed to Troy.
Pisistratus confirms the identity and recalls his own dead brother Antilochus.
Enough —
we shame the feast with weeping.
Let us remember supper now;
with dawn there will be time for all our tales, and tears enough to go with them.

scenes.title: Helen's Drug and the Beggar in Troy
scenes.card: Helen eases their grief with a drugged wine and recalls Odysseus sneaking into the enemy city disguised as a beggar.

subs.text: Scene three.
Helen's Drug and the Beggar in Troy.
Helen mixes a drug into the wine that quiets grief and anger.
Hear one deed of that man of endurance.
He scarred his own flesh with blows, threw a beggar's rags across his back,
and walked through the gates of Troy —
into the city of his enemies, looking like a slave.
Helen alone recognized and bathed him.
Only when I had sworn a great oath not to name him did he open to me the whole design of the Achaeans.
Odysseus killed Trojans and returned to the ships with intelligence.

scenes.card: Menelaus recalls the hollow wooden horse that smuggled Greek soldiers into the enemy city, and how Odysseus kept the hidden men silent.

subs.text: Scene four.
The Wooden Horse.
True, wife —
yet you tell only half.
Hear the horse's tale from within:
I crouched in that timber belly with the best of the Argives, and Odysseus held command of us all,
when you came circling in the dark.
Helen circled the horse and imitated the voices of the warriors' wives.
The hidden Greeks nearly answered.
Odysseus restrained them and silenced Anticlus.
Telemachus hears proof of his father's endurance and command under pressure.

scenes.title: Menelaus Wrestles Proteus
scenes.card: Menelaus tells how he wrestled a shape-changing sea god, who revealed that Odysseus is alive but held captive on a goddess's island.

subs.text: Scene five.
Menelaus Wrestles Proteus.
Son of Atreus, royal Menelaus, I came for this alone:
tell me plainly of my father Odysseus.
Did you hear that he lives, or must I mourn him?
Do not soften it out of pity —
tell me what your own eyes have met.
The gods held me windbound off Egypt, on the isle of Pharos, till hunger gnawed my crews —
until Eidothea, daughter of the sea's old man,
pitied me and taught me how to seize her father Proteus and wring the truth from him.
Menelaus and three men hid beneath sealskins and grappled the Old Man of the Sea.
Which of the gods taught you this trap, son of Atreus?
What do you want of me?
One more I saw, shedding great tears on an island:
Odysseus, held in the halls of the nymph Calypso,
with no ship and no companions to carry him over the sea's broad back.

scenes.title: The Gifts and the Eagle Omen
scenes.card: Telemachus insists on leaving; the royal couple give him gifts, and Helen reads an eagle seizing a goose as Odysseus's coming revenge.

subs.text: Scene six.
The Gifts and the Eagle Omen.
Stay with me a month, Telemachus, and I will send you off with horses and a shining chariot —
or does your heart already pull you home?
No horses, then, for rocky Ithaca —
take this instead:
a mixing bowl of wrought silver, its lip finished in gold, the work of Hephaestus himself.
And this gift from me, dear child —
a robe my own hands wove.
Let it lie in your mother's keeping until your wedding day, and let your bride wear the memory of Helen.
As the chariot rolls from the gate an eagle sweeps by on the right, a white goose in its talons —
and Helen cries out the sign:
so shall Odysseus, long away, swoop home upon the feasters in his hall and take his payment.

scenes.title: The Suitors Prepare an Ambush
scenes.card: On Ithaca, the suitors learn Telemachus has sailed and send a ship to ambush him; Penelope hears and collapses in fear.

subs.text: Scene seven.
The Suitors Prepare an Ambush.
When Telemachus will return your ship?
The suitors discover that the voyage truly occurred without their knowledge.
Antinous selects a crew and sails to the strait between Ithaca and Same to ambush the prince.
Queen, forgive the word I carry:
the suitors plot to cut Telemachus down at sea as he sails home.
I heard them lay the ambush with my own ears.
she collapses in fear.
Sleep, Penelope.
Take heart:
your son comes home, and a guide goes with him such as men pray to stand beside them.

sign.name: Vector
sign.operation: Cross-cut the threads, each in its own framing: the ambush ship pushing off, Medon at the door, Penelope on the floor; each leaves a gap the next fills.

scenes.world: A rocky island harbour and the smoky great hall in grey overcast daylight, then night in a bedchamber; silent-drama texture, quick cross-cutting.

captain.asks: Cross-cut three threads in their own framings: the ambush ship pushing off, Medon at the door, Penelope on the floor, each leaving a gap the next fills.
diagnosis: The sea thread holds: grey harbours and a rocky strait cut together as one vector.
The suitors are a modern casino table; Ithaca's hall becomes a 1930s gambling club.
Penelope's bedchamber thread is the strongest run: melodrama interiors match each other and the line.

prologue: Telemachus reaches Sparta, ruled by Menelaus and his wife Helen, who both knew his father at Troy. They tell him stories of Odysseus and, at last, real news. Meanwhile, back on Ithaca, the suitors discover he has left.
